title: Singapore MRT: weekday average daily tap-ins at Jurong East, per month
brief: Revision 3 (Haoyang Shang, 2026-11-10): ready for production immediately; no unscored pilots. What will the average daily number of tap-ins at Jurong East MRT station (PT_CODE EW24/NS1) be on weekdays that are not public holidays in the target month, as given by LTA DataMall's Passenger Volume by Train Stations file for that month? First prospective scored target: December 2026; lock 2026-11-30 23:59 SGT, expected release 2027-01-10. AccountKey access was verified and August–October 2026 archived. Baseline and resolution rules remain unchanged.
question: What will the average daily number of tap-ins at Jurong East MRT station (PT_CODE EW24/NS1) be on weekdays that are not public holidays in the target month, as given by LTA DataMall's Passenger Volume by Train Stations file for that month?

source.publisher: Land Transport Authority (LTA), LTA DataMall, 'Passenger Volume by Train Stations' (PV/Train). Built from fare-card taps (owner doc). Contact via DataMall 'Contact Us'.
source.access: AccountKey access verified on 2026-11-10: train and bus archives for August, September and October 2026 are available. The key is read only from LTA_API_KEY; GitHub Actions requires the repository secret of that name. Rotate the previously exposed key. Capture both kinds continuously; only missing available months are requested. DataMall retains only three months. Original registration instructions and pre-key findings are preserved in revision 2 history.
source.archive_policy: Use: allowed. Automated retrieval: allowed in writing, with a key. Redistribution: allowed by the dataset licence, with one clause of unclear scope. Evidence: (a) DataMall's API terms, accepted at registration: 'Use of the datasets is governed by the Singapore Open Data Licence'; 'you can use, access, call, command, query or request the API, whether commercially or non-commercially'; 'You can call the APIs up to 10 million times a day'; cl. 10(b) keep credentials confidential and 'shall not mis-present or mask your API Client's identity'; cl. 10(e) data 'must only be released on or after the Effective Date (if any)' [verified, datamall.lta.gov.sg/content/datamall/en/api-terms-of-service.html fetched 2026-11-09T01:06Z]. (b) Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0 on DataMall: 'use, access, download, copy, distribute, transmit, modify and adapt the datasets' with attribution [verified, .../SingaporeOpenDataLicence.html]. (c) Unclear scope (lesson 10): DataMall's website Terms of Use say 'the Contents of this website shall not be reproduced, republished ... without the prior written permission of LTA' (cl. 5, 21) and 'The Contents of this website are strictly for your personal and non-commercial use only' (cl. 23), under the heading 'Restrictions on Use of Contents' / 'Copyright' [verified, .../term-of-use.html, last updated 25 Aug 2022]. Sorted by docs/sources.md §9: retrieval is covered by the API ToS; use and redistribution of datasets by the licence; cl. 5/21/23 read as covering the website's own pages ('Except as otherwise provided'), not datasets served under the licence, which is an inference [inferred]. Conditions: licence notice on the site; key kept secret; no suggestion of LTA endorsement. Proposed arena inventory row: rights 'approved', pending maintainers. The optional publisher question is drafted in source.access; nobody sends it until a maintainer decides to.

target.population: Fare-card tap-ins (stored-value and contactless bank cards, per the doc) at gates of the Jurong East MRT interchange (East-West and North-South lines), on weekdays that are not public holidays. Transfers inside the paid area are not taps.
target.window: The target calendar month, rows with DAY_TYPE = 'WEEKDAY'. LTA's WEEKENDS/HOLIDAY type includes public holidays (owner doc), so the divisor excludes them.
target.calculation: From the month's file: sum TOTAL_TAP_IN_VOLUME over all TIME_PER_HOUR rows with PT_CODE = 'EW24/NS1' and DAY_TYPE = 'WEEKDAY', divided by the number of Monday-to-Friday dates in the month that are not Singapore gazetted public holidays (Ministry of Manpower list, frozen in the round at posting). Rounded to the nearest whole tap. If LTA changes the code for this station (new line stage; the Jurong Region Line opens from 2027 per the doc), the round names the alias in its text and the adapter keeps an alias table. Owner input to check on first download: September 2026, 2.06 million tap-ins at Jurong East over the month.

lock: 23:59 Singapore time on the last day before the target month starts. No unscored pilot requirement (owner decision 2026-11-10). First prospective scored month: December 2026, lock 2026-11-30 23:59 SGT; expected release 2027-01-10. November is already underway and is not retrospectively admitted. The reference is October 2026, already archived. Publish the round on main before lock; missing reference means do not post.
baseline: Ranked zero point mean_k(k=1, lag=1, rms_n=12) (owner decision, rev 2; rev 1 called it 'pv_persistence'): mean = the station's weekday average for the newest month in SSA's archive at lock, which is two months before the target. Spread, interim until 12 archived months exist: sd = mean x the RMS of LTA's system-wide MRT relative change over two months, 2023-2025 (5.43%; one-month lag 4.82%), a measured spread but measured on the network rather than the station; afterwards sd = the RMS of the rule's own relative errors over the last 12 resolved months. Zero-point family (G1): one parameterised reference 'mean_k(k, lag, rms_n)': the mean of the k most recent eligible values in the lock capture, after skipping 'lag' newer ones not yet published, with sd = the root-mean-square of that same rule's errors over the rms_n most recent resolved targets in the lock capture (G2). Persistence is mean_k(k=1). Measured only at system level (LTA 'PT Ridership Monthly 2019-2025' PDF, average daily MRT ridership, all days, 36 months 2023-2025): persistence MAPE 3.72% (lag 1), 4.35% (lag 2); same month last year 9.15%; last year x last month's year-on-year ratio 4.34%. Largest moves: July (school term) +9.9% to +11.3%, December -5.4% to -6.7%, January +5.1% to +12.2%. Station-level weekday movement, noise and holiday effects are unmeasured: the first download gives three months, i.e. two changes [unverified]. Before the first scored round, a maintainer re-runs this check on the archive: the round is not scored if the reference's 90% interval would not have covered the archived months. After 12 months, a year-on-year reference (as 'yoy4' does for Seattle) is to be added as a shown baseline.
resolution: The first successful download, at or after 00:00 SGT on the 10th of the following month, of a file whose YEAR_MONTH is the target month. LTA's guide says the previous month's data 'is now generated on 10th of the month' (release note 6.1.1, 9 Oct 2024) and 'By 10th of every month' (§2.8); no time is given. Route A polls every 6 hours from the 10th; Route B is a named person's task on the 10th or 11th. The archived zip (bytes, sha256) is the record; LTA keeps no history, so a later download is not possible after three months. Revisions: none expected (doc); the first archived file wins.
missing_data_policy: (1) No file for the target month archived by 23:59 SGT on the 17th: the round is cancelled. (2) Jurong East missing from the file, or its WEEKDAY tap-ins zero in any hour 06-22: the round is cancelled and the card revised. (3) The reference month missing from the archive at lock: the round is not posted (a two-months-back file is not substituted under lock B). (4) A station code change announced before the lock is handled by the alias table; one that appears only in the file cancels the round. (5) Route B: if the named person has not filed the month by the 17th, (1) applies, and the watch notifies maintainers from the 11th (as for YouGov, lesson 4).
scoring: SSA topline scoring: mean and sd (sd > 0) or a quantile map including 0.5, CRPS; continuous_normal. Skill = 1 - CRPS(entrant) / CRPS(mean_k(k=1, lag=1, rms_n=12)). noise_floor is the wrong tool here (fare-card counts have no sampling noise, like Civiqs' smoothed series, docs/sources.md §1.4); the gate is the persistence error, which at system level is 3.7-4.4% a month. One round a month, so a year gives 12 scored rounds per station.

Cl. 13: 'caching and links to, and the framing of this website or any of the Contents are prohibited' except as set forth. Computed, 2023-2025: persistence MAPE 3.72% (RMS 4.82%, max 12.2%), two months back 4.35% (RMS 5.43%), same month last year 9.15%, YoY-ratio 4.34%. It stops at December 2025 and gives no station detail.

[search result 2026-11-09, not fetched] data.gov.sg has only annual network-level ridership ('Public Transport Operation And Ridership, Annual'; 'Public Transport Utilisation - Average Public Transport Ridership', 1995-2024). No keyless monthly station-level equivalent of PV/Train was found on data.gov.sg; 'I did not find it' is not proof it does not exist.

evidence.finding: [owner input, partly checked] Consistent with LTA's guide: 'by 10th of every month', last three months only, link to a zipped CSV. Needs fixing or checking: (1) link expiry: the guide says 15 minutes, the doc 5 minutes (X-Amz-Expires=300); download at once either way; (2) the licence line 'Singapore Open Data Licence via the DataMall terms' omits that the DataMall website Terms of Use restrict reproduction of site Contents; (3) September 2026 '87 million tap-ins' against LTA's 2025 average daily MRT+LRT ridership of about 3.45-3.88 million (roughly 104-116 million a month): the gap may come from how LTA counts ridership (per line) versus gate taps, which should be checked on the first file [unverified]; (4) the lock on the 8th falls after the month's behaviour, with real-time crowd data public. Station and OD rankings (the doc's other questions) are left to later rounds.

assumptions: Owner decision, 2026-11-10: remove the two unscored pilots and prepare production now. First prospective target December 2026, then monthly; all rounds scored. Existing lock, baseline, cancellation and resolution rules remain in force.
Full card instead of a blocked draft, per the owner's 2026-11-08 update: a maintainer may register for DataMall; the agent did not.

Route A (automated with a key) proposed over Route B (manual): the API ToS names automated calls, so a manual step adds a person and a deadline without a rights gain. Runner-up: Route B, kept as fallback if DataMall blocks datacenter IPs (lesson 3) or maintainers prefer the key off CI.

Weekday average excluding public holidays, not the month's total. Reason: month length and holiday count change the total by several percent with no change in behaviour. Runner-up: total tap-ins, simpler but calendar-driven.

The first download should happen as soon as the key exists, even before approval, because each month older than three is gone for good; archiving is not scoring. This is a recommendation for maintainers, not an action the agent took.

Suggested arena names: tracker 'sg_lta_pv'; series 'sg_pv_train_ew24ns1_weekday_tapin'; adapter ssa/adapters/sg_lta_pv.py; archive sources/lta-pv/train/; round_id 'sg-pv-train-je-<YYYY-MM>'. Naming only.
